name: Flagsmith JavaScript Client
solves: Provides feature flag evaluation and remote config management for JavaScript applications via the Flagsmith platform, supporting both hosted and self-hosted backends with identity-based targeting, traits, real-time updates via SSE, caching, and integrations with Datadog, Dynatrace, and Sentry.
best_for: React and React Native apps needing feature flags with a provider/hooks pattern and typed flag keys
Next.js projects requiring SSR-compatible feature flags with server state hydration and caching
Teams wanting a self-hostable feature flag backend with a managed SaaS fallback option
Applications needing identity-based flag targeting with user traits and transient identities
Projects requiring real-time flag updates via server-sent events without polling
skip_when: You need a vendor-neutral SDK and prefer the OpenFeature standard across multiple providers
Your project is Python-only or backend-only with no JavaScript runtime
You want purely local/in-code feature flag evaluation without any external API dependency
You need a lightweight boolean-only toggle and don't want a full platform SDK with analytics, Datadog, and Dynatrace integrations
You are already deeply integrated with LaunchDarkly or another provider and switching cost is unjustified

hosted_alternative.name: Flagsmith Cloud
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Free tier up to 50k requests/month; paid plans start at $45/month for additional seats, environments, and API calls
